# DISPATCH (coma) — actionable tasks, hardest first

**Generated by `ops/gen_dispatch.py --apply --pack coma`. Do not edit by hand.**

This is the operator's sheet, not an agent's. It replaced the bootstrap's
"find the next task" step: task selection is a human decision now, because
difficulty determines which agent gets the work and only you know what is
available. Read the score, pick the agent, paste the task file — the file is
self-contained and needs no other preamble.

**Difficulty** is the routing composite (V1 logic, V2 context, V3 dependency
depth) from `.claude/skills/bootstrapping-task-pack-infrastructure/reference/task-routing-score.md`.
**Test length** is deliberately separate: it routes to a *runner*, not a model.
Anything at 4 or 5 does not belong in an interactive session at all — the
operator starts it detached and the agent reads the verdict from the manifest.
